title: Answer first. Upsell second.
fix: Let a new user try one complete answer before asking them to sign up.

title: Make every handoff a link.
fix: Include a working deep link and carry the conversation into the next step.

title: Check the facts about people.
fix: Verify roles and affiliations against a source before stating them as fact.

title: Deliver the image you promise.
fix: Check that media is attached. Verify requested text before sending an image.

title: Keep voice clear over time.
fix: Monitor audio quality and refresh degraded sessions before a user has to restart.

title: Make paid access dependable.
fix: Reconcile purchases, restore missing access, and offer credits for documented outages.

title: Give developers time to adapt.
fix: Publish a deprecation window, test tool-enabled output, and keep support reachable.

title: Turn complaints into tracked fixes.
fix: Create a ticket from a bug report, group duplicates, and send a tracking link.

title: Keep memory consistent.
fix: Give people an editable memory profile and consistent persona settings across sessions.

title: Make errors actionable.
fix: Replace raw errors with a clear next step, a retry, and a status link.

title: Check outbound links.
fix: Validate destinations and clearly label external sites before sending users away.

title: Let tables turn sideways.
fix: Support landscape answers and horizontal scrolling for wide tables and code.

title: Keep avatars in one piece.
fix: Check animation collisions so hands stay outside clothing.

title: Bring context into standalone Grok.
fix: Bring source-linked post explanations and live-topic context into the standalone app.

title: Explain capability changes.
fix: Show what changed, why it changed, and what people can do next.

title: Close the desktop–mobile gaps.
fix: Align controls, make built-in skills optional, and fix the API-key setup flow.
